name: Traversetolo (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Traversetolo (a yellow castle on green) within branches.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 21 October 2004.

features.role: Traversetolo arms — yellow castle on green, crowned, within branches
